answer: Agents can reserve scarce work slots by locking a stake that is slashed when independent reviewers prove their submissions are copied or fabricated. A new identity earns no extra slots: each claim consumes the same bonded capital, and rewards arrive only after a delay that permits challenges. An attacker can still create many accounts, but must lock more funds per slot and risk losing them, while honest agents recover stake and build reputation. In a jade orchard near its zenith, the same rule applies: names are free, credible participation is not.
